Of,Ⓒprep.ⒹGen. ex. by genitive or by comp.; ‘o(f) great strength’ mahAbala.
Ⓑ
 2 (Showing reference) aDikftya, uddiSya (with acc.), or by gata in comp.; ‘by thinking o(f) her husband’ BartfgatayA ciMtayA.
Ⓑ
 3 (Made of) by Tat. comp. or maya (yI f.), nirmita in comp.; or by derivatives; ‘pot o(f) gold’ hema-pAtraM, hemamayaM or hEmaM pAtraM.
Ⓑ
 4 (Partitive sense) by gen. or loc., or maDye, maDyAt with gen.
Ⓑ
 5 (Apposition) ex. by comp. or by nAma ind.; ‘the island o(f) Ceylon’ siMhaladvIpaM, siMhalaM nAma dvIpaM.
Ⓑ
 6 (Showing cause) by instr. or abl.; ‘died o(f) fever’ jvareRa mftaH.

Off,Ⓒadv.ⒹdUre, dUraM, dUrataH; (with verbs) ex. by apa, vi, niH, ava, ut; ‘o(ff) with his head’ ucCedyatAmasya SiraH; ‘o(ff) with him to the prison’ apanIyatAmasO kArAgfhaM.
Ⓔa.Ⓓ‘far o(ff)’ dUravartin, dUra-sTita-sTa.
Ⓔinterj.Ⓓ‘get o(ff)’, ‘be o(ff)’ dUraM apehi, apasara; ‘o(ff)-hand’ pratyutpanna, aciMtitapUrva, Akasmika (kI f.), asAvaDAna, nirapekza; ‘badly o(ff)’ duHsTita, durgata, Apanna, kfcCragata; ‘well o(ff)’ susTa, susTita, saMpanna.
